cases.description: a three-tier run on declared bindings with an independent observer
a chain missing the Work tier
Work claims the settle verb the table withholds
Work runs on a scope that is not inside its parent
the worker settles the report it produced
the producing binding observes its own output
Work declares an external-world effect this phase refuses
an invocation omits its model version
Work runs on the controller binding, collapsing the dyad

note: Every separation rule SDLC.md states has one run that satisfies it and one that defeats it. A rule with no defeating case is a rule nothing proves is enforced.
